# OnwardCraft

> An independent SEO publication for small businesses. Practical guides, checklists, benchmark data, and local search research for owners who do their own SEO.

## What this is

OnwardCraft is an independent publication covering one subject: search engine optimization for small businesses. It is not an agency. It sells no services, takes no clients, accepts no sponsorship or paid placement, and runs no advertising. The only thing it asks readers for is an email address for a free fortnightly newsletter.

Editorial standards:

- **One subject only** — We cover search. Not ads, not social, not branding. A narrow desk is the only way a small publication earns the right to be believed on anything.
- **No invented numbers** — Every figure is either sourced and linked, or labelled as a benchmark or an estimate. We never present a projection as a measured result.
- **Nothing is for sale here** — We do not sell SEO services, take placement fees, or rank anyone in exchange for money. The newsletter is free and the only thing we ask for.
- **Local research, not find-and-replace** — City guides are written from that market’s own search demand, seasonality, and geography — not one template with the city name swapped out.
- **Corrections in public** — When we get something wrong we fix the page and say what changed, rather than quietly editing it away.

Written by The OnwardCraft Desk. OnwardCraft is a small independent desk covering search — and only search — for owner-operated businesses. We publish what we can verify, label every estimate as an estimate, and correct the record in public.

The full archive was reviewed and republished on 2026-09-21.

## City guides

A local search guide for every one of 160 US metros: one market overview per city at /{city}/, plus 320 topic guides at /{city}/local-seo/ and /{city}/seo-services/. Each is written from that metro's own search demand, seasonality, geography and local price level rather than a shared template, which is why the Denver guide covers hail season and the Phoenix guide does not.

Cost figures in the city guides are market benchmarks collected from published local rates. They are not quotes — OnwardCraft does not sell the work being priced. Charts labelled illustrative show the shape of a seasonal pattern, not a measurement.

Full index: https://onwardcraft.com/locations/
